# Superseded

The content previously split between `gcf_results.Rmd` and
`gcf_results_full.Rmd` has been consolidated into a single document:
**`gcf_results_full.Rmd`**.

That file now contains everything this one used to (Overview, BGC
inventory, GCF characterization, richness by clinical group) plus the
statistically rigorous full-cohort hypothesis testing (Fisher/CMH/GLM over
every qualifying GCF, not a pre-selected top-20 subset) that this document's
own "Scope" section had already flagged as the correct approach.

This file is kept only so old links/references don't 404; please knit and
read `gcf_results_full.Rmd` going forward. It can be deleted once nothing
external still points to `gcf_results.Rmd`.
